authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / Office for National Statistics
note: Previously unused official no-login source window. Planning Data reports 344 local authority districts, administrative boundaries supplied by ONS, OGL v3.0. Individual entities expose stable statistical-geography references and full downloadable geometry. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition still provides no authoritative LAD/GSS reference, LPA identifier, postcode, UPRN, coordinate, local-plan-boundary reference, or equivalent binding identifier. Selecting any of the 344 districts would therefore be guessing. No source-area or parcel record accepted; no accepted Plan0 package emitted.
